answer: The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in copper, expire in lotus, and sable lists each expiry. An copycat running 97 aliases hence needs 52 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3780 identities would post 2551 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
